last.verdict: Opendoor bought far more homes but earned less on each sale, and it expects profit dollars to shrink again next quarter.

takeaways.label: Margins missed
takeaways.text: Contribution margin, the profit left after direct selling and holding costs, fell to 3.3% from 5.8% last quarter, below the 4%–4.5% outlook. Profit dropped to $34M from $51M.

takeaways.label: Weaker profit outlook
takeaways.text: Fourth-quarter revenue is guided up at least 40% year over year, but profit dollars are expected to fall again. Adjusted EBITDA loss is guided to $70M–$85M, versus $31M this quarter.

takeaways.label: Inventory and debt swelling
takeaways.text: Inventory reached $2.57B (7,596 homes) from $925M at year-start. Short-term bank debt rose to $2.0B, and nine-month operating cash outflow hit $1.8B.

takeaways.label: Aging homes
takeaways.text: Homes listed over 120 days rose to 18% of listed inventory from 9% last quarter. Management admits it is behind on its goal of positive adjusted net income by year-end.

history.verdict: Investors sold on a weak margin outlook despite revenue and cash-burn improvement.

reasons.label: Lower margin outlook
reasons.text: Next-quarter contribution margin guided to 4%–4.5%, below this quarter's 5.8%, blamed on seasonality.

reasons.label: Sales far below last year
reasons.text: Revenue was $883M, down about 44% from a year ago, and below analyst estimates.

reasons.label: Bigger loss, mostly stock pay
reasons.text: Net loss was $162M versus $29M a year ago, driven by about $119M of stock-based pay.
